name: Glistening oil
description: The holy oil flowing from Norn's body that erases memory and desire and reorders minds.

description_citations.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
timeline.quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.
